steps.title: Welcome to Polygonal Primordials
steps.body: You're about to watch digital life evolve.

steps.title: The Simulation Viewport
steps.body: This is the main view. Each shape is a creature.

steps.title: Live Statistics
steps.body: Open the Stats panel to see performance data.

steps.title: Pause and Observe
steps.body: Press SPACE to pause the simulation.

steps.title: Click an Entity
steps.body: Click on any creature to select it.

steps.title: Change the Rules
steps.body: Open the Parameters panel to tweak mutation rates.

steps.title: Explore the Workshop
steps.body: Open the Workshop panel to subscribe to community mods.

steps.title: Create Your Own
steps.body: Open the Visual Scripts panel to build custom node graphs.
